note: Toolchains are Microsoft's and are not in the repository: tools/get_toolchain.md says how to unpack them into toolchain/. Profiles are the flag sets functions compile with; flag discovery (python -m baa flags) picks each library's.

vc71.version: 13.10.3052 (Visual C++ Toolkit 2003; the exe's C objects are 13.10.3077)

ue3.note: /GS: EH frames push __security_cookie^esp (22k functions). /arch:SSE: game code does float math in SSE (75% of its float functions use xmm)

ue3_o1.note: FMOD: /O1 with the precise floating-point model (every float assignment is stored and reloaded; operand order follows the source)

ue3_x87.note: ue3 flags without /arch:SSE: the third-party code at 01760000-01b54000 and 01b8d000-01c00000 uses x87 only | /fp:precise (2026-11-07): this code calls _CIsin/_CIcos/_CIlog/_CIsqrt/_CIexp, which VC8 inlines under /fp:fast; 250/250 sampled matches still match

lib_c71.note: third-party C built with VS.NET 2003 (Rich header: 24 C objects 13.10.3077)

ue3_x87_gsoff.note: ue3_x87 with /GS-: third-party code at 017f8000-0188f000 (FCollada and neighbours), 01a27000-01a38000 and 01bf9000-01bfe000 has EH frames without the security cookie VC8 /GS always adds to them (found 2026-11-07) | /fp:precise (2026-11-07): this code calls _CIsin/_CIcos/_CIlog/_CIsqrt/_CIexp, which VC8 inlines under /fp:fast; 250/250 sampled matches still match
